name: upsert_entry_link
description:
Creates or updates an Entry Link between two Entries in Knowledge Catalog.

Set `allow_missing = true` to upsert (create a new Entry Link inside an Entry Group or Context Set if it does not exist, or update an existing Entry Link and its aspects in place).

EntryLinkReference.description: Reference to an Entry connected by an Entry Link.

name.description: Required. Relative resource name of the referenced Entry: `projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entry_group_id}/entries/{entry_id}`

path.description: Optional. Path within the Entry referenced by the link (for example, `Schema.customer_id` for a column-level link). Leave empty to reference the Entry as a whole.

type.description: Required. Directionality role of this Entry in the link: - `UNSPECIFIED`: For non-directional Entry Link Types (`related`, `synonym`, `schema-join`). - `SOURCE`: Source Entry in a directional Entry Link (`definition`, `reference`). - `TARGET`: Target Entry in a directional Entry Link (`definition`, `reference`).
x-google-enum-descriptions: Unspecified reference type. Implies that the Entry is referenced in a non-directional Entry Link.
The Entry is referenced as the source of the directional Entry Link.
The Entry is referenced as the target of the directional Entry Link.

allowMissing.description: Optional. If true, creates the Entry Link if it does not already exist (upsert). Set `allow_missing = true` when creating a new Entry Link.

aspectKeys.description: Optional. Aspect keys to modify when updating an existing Entry Link's aspects (`{project_id_or_number}.{location}.{aspect_type_id}`). If empty, the service modifies the aspects present in `aspects`.

aspects.description: Optional. Map of aspect keys (`{project_id_or_number}.{location}.{aspect_type_id}`) to structured JSON payloads attached to the Entry Link (for example, `dataplex-types.global.schema-join` on a `schema-join` Entry Link).

entryLinkType.description: Required. Resource name of the Entry Link Type: `projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location}/entryLinkTypes/{entry_link_type_id}` Common system Entry Link Types: - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/related` (undirected link between two related Entries; both references use `type: UNSPECIFIED`) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/definition` (directional link from a glossary term or concept `SOURCE` to a data asset or column `TARGET`) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/synonym` (undirected link between synonym terms; both references use `type: UNSPECIFIED`) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/reference` (directional reference from a `SOURCE` Entry to a `TARGET` Entry) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/schema-join` (undirected column-level join between two Entries; attach the `dataplex-types.global.schema-join` aspect in `aspects`)

entryReferences.description: Required. The two Entries connected by this Entry Link. Must contain exactly two `EntryLinkReference` items.

name.description: Required. Full resource name of the Entry Link to create or update: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entry_group}/entryLinks/{entry_link_id}` The `entry_link_id` must be 1-63 characters, start with a lowercase letter, end with a lowercase letter or number, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
